production_checkpoint.voice_generation: 8 original TTS calls completed; scenes 4-6 were re-run once because the first batched tool output was truncated before their URLs/timestamps could be safely captured. Original timestamps were not fabricated.

production_checkpoint.image_pricing_checked: Current fal pricing returned $1/unit for GPT Image 2.5 Flare text-to-image/edit. Re-generating 8 lost edit outputs would add about $8 after about $9 of image jobs had already been submitted.
production_checkpoint.blocker: Cost guard triggered. Continuing would require re-running eight $1 image edits solely to recover outputs lost by tool-response parsing. Per skill rule to keep usage sparse and abort when costs run out of hand, production stopped before music/SFX/builder/render/upload.
production_checkpoint.coexistence: Fresh main observed before write; no published.json change because no upload occurred.

script.hook: This humanoid robot helped build 30,000 BMWs. And BMW is already testing its replacement.
scenes: In 2025, BMW put Figure 02 on a real X3 line in South Carolina.
It positioned sheet-metal parts for welding, five days a week.
In ten months: 90,000 parts, 1,250 hours, and 1.2 million steps.
The test exposed weaknesses too. Figure says its forearm was the biggest hardware failure point.
Those lessons shaped Figure 03, now back at BMW for harder logistics work.
It sorts mixed parts into the exact sequence assembly workers need.
The future didn't arrive with a robot uprising. It arrived one repetitive job at a time.
script.title: This Robot Helped Build 30,000 BMWs
script.description: A humanoid robot spent months on a real BMW production line, moving tens of thousands of parts. Now its successor is being tested on harder factory logistics. 🔔 Follow for the next true story. #shorts #robotics #AI #BMW #futuretech
